classification: OWNER_APPROVED_ADAPTATION: every partner carries a Sync Level 1..50 and Sync EXP (BATTLE_MODE_PRISM_AND_JOURNEY_20261109); a battle reads it as a modifier on a copy of the individual and never writes it into the native fields

saveField.path: progression.syncLevels = { version: 1, partners: { [instanceId]: { level, exp, rebirths } }, crystals }
saveField.migration: none: a save without it reads every partner as Lv.1 with no EXP; unknown or broken entries normalize field by field (productSyncLevel.normalizeSyncLevels)

rules.curve: EXP to the next level = round(80 x level^1.35); Lv.50 is the cap and overflow EXP becomes crystal points
rules.battle: auto battle: max HP / TP +0.6 % a level and one native curve step per breakthrough (Lv.10/20/30/40/50) on a copy; finishMatch restores the saved vitals and steps
rules.caps: title matches and championships cap the level at 10 + 5 x tamer rank (at most 50); password, link and online battles ignore it and pay no EXP
rules.arena: Data Arena partner power x (1 + 0.004 per level + 0.02 per breakthrough)
rules.rebirth: a rebirth keeps 30 % of the level; evolution keeps all of it

notChanged: the native individual fields, battle codes and match tables
